title: Structured compatibility matrix and snapshot publishing workflow for newly-ingested models
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description: Create and roll out a deterministic workflow that produces: (1) a compatibility matrix for each newly-ingested model variant (runtime kernels, quantization tiers, sequence length expectations, supported features), (2) a published performance snapshot (latency percentiles, throughput curves, memory/VRAM footprint, recommended batch sizing) and (3) a recommended version-pinning rationale note that is surfaced in the model catalog and the onboarding docs. The goal is to reduce time-to-publish for new models, make pin decisions auditable, and give SDK/Console teams stable metadata to drive routing, fallbacks, and cost-estimation tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible job produces a compatibility matrix JSON and human-readable summary for any ingested model variant
Performance snapshot includes p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec at 1/8/32 sequence lengths, and memory footprint for default batch sizes
Pin rationale field auto-populates with candidate pin (hash or variant id) and a short reason (e.g., stability, best-efficiency) and is editable by release owners
Catalog UI shows the new compatibility badge and links to the snapshot for at least three recently-ingested models in staging
SDK routing respects the published recommended quant level and falls back to next compatible variant when unavailable
Docs PR with onboarding checklist, example manifest, and tie-in to rollout/rollback playbook merged and reviewed
Security review sign-off recorded for the snapshot tooling because it touches model artifacts and storage locations
tasks: Design compatibility schema (fields: kernel_support, quant_tier, max_seq, min_seq, recommended_batch, kv_cache_behavior)
Extend ingest pipeline to run perf harnesses in isolated staging infra and emit snapshot artifacts
Add pin_rationale field to catalog manifest and UI, with edit history and author attribution
Author docs: onboarding checklist, example compatibility matrix, how-to interpret snapshot charts
Integrate snapshot links into Console model detail page and SDK metadata endpoints
Add automated lint and CI check that prevents publishing a model without a snapshot or explicit pin decision
Coordinate security review and perform threat-model for stored snapshot artifacts
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with Runtime, Catalog, Console, SDK, and Security. Agreed to unify on a single compatibility schema rather than team-specific fields. Action: Runtime to propose kernel_support enum.

2026-03-02: Runtime proposed kernel_support values: ['cuda-attn-v2','cuda-attn-v1','fallback-cpu','triton-optimized']. Also added quant_tier recommendation levels: Q8, Q4, HF-INT8. Liam flagged that Q4 testing infra needs a tease-out due to tooling gaps.

2026-03-04: Proof-of-concept ingest run for 'thirdparty/llama-3-small' executed in staging. Snapshot produced but p99 latency had wide variance; identified source as cold KV-cache behavior. Decided to include 'kv_cache_warmup_guidance' in snapshot notes.

2026-03-07: Design review requested for Catalog UI badge mockups. DES-1174 (internal design task) provided feedback: badge should be color-coded by 'compatibility tier' and hovercard to surface recommended pin and link to snapshot PDF.

2026-03-09: Updated docs draft added to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/docs/model-catalog/compatibility-onboarding-draft. Requesting PM review from Noor Shah and Security review initiation (ticket SEC-914).

2026-03-10: CI check prototype added to catalog-ingest repo that fails publish if 'snapshot_url' missing. Integration tests unstable on macOS runners; switching to linux-gpu CI pool. Liam assigned to resolve CI flakiness.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Perf harnesses consume expensive GPU time and slow onboarding cadence. Mitigation: run cheap synthetic microbenchmarks first and gate full harness to candidates that pass smoke checks.
Risk: Snapshot artifacts could leak model weights via side channels. Mitigation: restrict snapshot storage to internal buckets with KMS encryption and limit access to catalog-release role.
Risk: SDKs and Console require backward-compatible metadata. Mitigation: add version field to compatibility schema and maintain v1/v2 adapters in ingest service for 3 months.
Risk: Pin decisions may be controversial across teams. Mitigation: require Pin Rationale and an opt-in 'experimental' flag for non-pinned variants for 2-week canaries.
